rules.title: Sustained request latency
rules.description: Request latency repeatedly exceeded the service objective.
rules.recommendation: Inspect dependency timings, queue depth, and connection-pool saturation.

rules.title: Service error burst
rules.recommendation: Compare the newest errors with the last deployment and downstream health.

rules.title: RAN downlink saturation
rules.description: Downlink PRB utilization is near saturation.
rules.recommendation: Inspect cell load, traffic steering, and neighbouring-cell capacity.

rules.title: Elevated packet loss
rules.description: Packet loss exceeded the reliability threshold.
rules.recommendation: Check transport congestion, radio quality, and retransmission rates.

rules.title: Weak radio quality
rules.recommendation: Inspect interference, coverage, UE distribution, and handover behaviour.

rules.title: Public administration exposure
rules.description: An administrative interface is reachable from the public internet.
rules.recommendation: Restrict administration to a VPN, bastion, or trusted management network.

rules.title: Suspicious authentication failure
rules.description: A privileged login failed from an untrusted network.
rules.recommendation: Review source addresses, rotate exposed credentials, and inspect audit logs.
